name: NoMoreHelpButton
description: This mod hides the annoying help button and the exit button in the EditorPauseLayer for mobile creators!

help-button-only.name: Only Help Button
help-button-only.description: Toggle off this checkbox and then the help button appear again without restarting. Easy as that.

exit-button-only.name: Only Exit Button
exit-button-only.description: The exact same as the first one.
